import os,stat,json,hashlib,base64
p='/tmp/ricochet-measured-cpu-round-gameplay-oct27/serial/round-before.png'
f=open(p,"rb");s=os.fstat(f.fileno())
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode)
identity=[s.st_dev,s.st_ino,s.st_size,s.st_mtime_ns,s.st_ctime_ns]
assert s.st_size<=2097152
h=hashlib.sha256();left=s.st_size
while left:
 b=f.read(min(8192,left));assert b;h.update(b);left-=len(b)
digest=h.hexdigest()
t=os.fstat(f.fileno());u=os.stat(p)
assert identity==[t.st_dev,t.st_ino,t.st_size,t.st_mtime_ns,t.st_ctime_ns]
assert identity==[u.st_dev,u.st_ino,u.st_size,u.st_mtime_ns,u.st_ctime_ns]
print(json.dumps(dict(bytes=s.st_size,identity=identity,sha256=digest)))
